title: Facilitating Cross-border Taxi Transfers between Singapore and Johor While Safeguarding Singapore P2P Drives' Livelihoods
what_it_is: Facilitating Cross-border Taxi Transfers between Singapore and Johor While Safeguarding Singapore P2P Drives' Livelihoods

sections.label: LTA impounds illegal vehicles
sections.summary: Since July, LTA has impounded 107 vehicles whose drivers were caught providing illegal services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Since July this year, the LTA has impounded 107 vehicles whose drivers were caught providing illegal services.

sections.label: Cross Border Taxi Scheme liberalisation
sections.summary: Under the Cross Border Taxi Scheme, Singapore is discussing with Malaysia options to liberalise it, including drop-offs anywhere in Singapore and Johor Bahru.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For instance, under the Cross Border Taxi Scheme, we are discussing with Malaysia possible options to liberalise the scheme, including to allow Malaysian cross-border taxis to drop off passengers anywhere in Singapore, and Singaporean taxis to do likewise in Johor Bahru.

sections.label: Engagement and location tracking measures
sections.summary: Singapore will continue engaging NTA and NPHVA, and is exploring location tracking including ERP 2.0 to prevent illegal cross-border taxi trips.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We will continue to engage the National Taxi Association (NTA) and the National Private Hire Vehicles Association (NPHVA) to take in their suggestions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We are also exploring using location tracking, including ERP 2.0, and other measures to prevent illegal trips by cross-border taxis within Singapore.

sections.label: Scheme relevance for cross-border drivers
sections.summary: Ensuring the scheme remains relevant as consumption patterns change is critical as it is a livelihood stream for 200 Singapore cross-border drivers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
sentences.text: Ensuring that the scheme remains relevant as consumption patterns change is critical, as this is a livelihood stream for 200 of our Singapore cross-border drivers.

sections.label: Drop-off points and MOT discussions
sections.summary: MOT and Malaysian authorities discussed a higher taxi quota, larger multi-purpose vehicle taxi models and ride-hailing apps for bookings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: And thirdly, when the Senior Minister of State says that LTA wants to increase the number of drop-off points in Malaysia and Singapore – currently, there is only one drop-off point in Johor Bahru and it is in Larkin; and in Singapore, there is one drop-off point – how many drop-off points is MOT thinking of having?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There have been several discussions between Singapore's MOT as well as Malaysia's Ministry of Transport and Agensi Pengangkutan Awam Darat (APAD).

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Amongst the discussion points that we have include a higher quota of taxis for each country, the introduction of larger multi-purpose vehicle taxi models and the use of ride-hailing apps to make bookings.

sections.label: Fleet size and fare undercutting
sections.summary: Discussions with Malaysian authorities include allowing Singapore and Malaysian vehicles to drop off at any point in Singapore and Johor Bahru.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: So, when we increase the fleet size and also liberalise the cross-border taxi services, how could we ensure that the parties will not undercut the fare?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I had shared in my main reply that part of the discussions that we are having with the Malaysian authorities is to allow Singapore as well as Malaysian vehicles to drop off at any point in Singapore and in Johor Bahru, because there is demand, this is a need that has been expressed by commuters.

sections.label: Cross Border Taxi Scheme review
sections.summary: The review of the Cross Border Taxi Scheme will involve consulting associations to ensure reasonable fares and viable cross-border trips for Singaporean drivers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As part of the review of the Cross Border Taxi Scheme, we will be consulting our associations to ensure that fares are reasonable to our passengers, while providing assurance to Singaporean drivers that cross-border trips are viable, given their operational cost.
